import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    p=params
    term1 = p[0]*t**2*np.exp(-p[1]*x**2)
    term2 = p[2]*np.exp(-p[3]*v**2)
    term3 = p[4]*v**2/(1+p[5]*v**2)*t**2
    term4 = p[6]*np.exp(-p[7]*x**2)*v**2/(1+p[8]*v**2)
    return term1+term2+term3+term4+p[9]*x*0

import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    p=params
    term1 = p[0]*t**2/(1+p[1]*t**2)*v**2/(1+p[2]*v**2)
    term2 = p[3]*np.exp(-p[4]*x**2)*np.exp(-p[5]*v**2)
    term3 = p[6]*np.exp(-p[7]*x**2)*v**2/(1+p[8]*v**2)
    term4 = p[9]*t
    return term1+term2+term3+term4
